name: SchemeControl
summary: Lets a person choose the colour scheme, applies it at once without a page flash and remembers it for the next visit. Three forms over one choice (ID3): a three-way choice of light, dark and system (the default, because following the system is a third answer, not "off"); a dark-mode Switch for a settings list, where off means light; and an icon button named by what it does, for a header with no room for either. Not for contrast or density (use SegmentedControl or Switch with your own setting). Composes SegmentedControl, Switch and Button and adds no styles of its own; the choice itself is `useScheme`, which a site can use to drive any control.
a11y: The choice is a SegmentedControl (a named radio group, one tab stop, arrow keys); the switch is a Switch named by its setting; the button is named by what it does ("Switch to dark mode"), shown as its tooltip, and its name changes with the scheme. The change applies with motion suspended, so the page switches in one frame.

keys.action: choose the next or previous scheme (choice form)
toggles dark mode (switch form) or switches the scheme (button form)

props.name: form
props.description: `choice` (default): light, dark or system side by side. `switch`: one dark-mode Switch, for a settings list. `button`: one icon button named by what it does, the documented option for a tight site header.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the choice: "Colour scheme". The choice form's group name.

props.name: words
props.description: The words a person reads, from your content; English defaults.

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: The choice form shows only each option's icon; each word becomes its tooltip and accessible name.

props.name: size
props.description: The choice and button forms' size on the Button scale (default `s`); the switch form maps to its nearest size.

props.name: storageKey
props.description: Where the choice is remembered (localStorage). Default `design-library.scheme`.

props.name: root
props.description: The element that carries `data-scheme`. Default the document root; pass a subtree for a preview.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Told of each new choice, after it is applied and remembered.

props.name: light
props.description: The choice's option for the light scheme. Default "Light".

props.name: dark
props.description: The choice's option for the dark scheme. Default "Dark".

props.name: system
props.description: The choice's option that follows the system setting. Default "System".

props.name: switch
props.description: The switch form's label, naming the setting. Default "Dark mode".

props.name: toDark
props.description: The button form's name in the light scheme, by what it does. Default "Switch to dark mode".

props.name: toLight
props.description: The button form's name in the dark scheme. Default "Switch to light mode".
